info.description:
Platform API to order and manage cloud resources — managed databases, apps, VMs (app servers), AI models, and public API endpoints — on the DADA Cloud platform.
Mutations are asynchronous: create/update/delete enqueue an operation and return 202 Accepted with an operation object; poll GET /projects/{projectId}/operations/{operationId} until the operation reaches a terminal status (Ready or Failed).
info.title: DADA Cloud Console API

get.description: Returns operations in the WaitingForApproval state across all projects where the caller is a platform-admin, each with the project name and requester. Read-only. The GPU-model creation gate is the first consumer.
get.summary: List operations awaiting admin approval

post.description: Approves a WaitingForApproval operation, transitioning it to Created so the dispatcher executes it. Platform-admin only. An optional note is recorded in the audit trail.

parameters.description: Optional object with a note string
parameters.name: body

post.description: Rejects a WaitingForApproval operation, transitioning it to Cancelled. Platform-admin only. A reason is required and surfaced to the requester in the operations timeline.

parameters.description: Object with a required reason string
parameters.name: body

post.description: Authenticates a user by username or email plus password and returns a JWT bearer token. Public endpoint — no authentication required. Use the returned token as the Authorization: Bearer header for every other endpoint.
post.summary: Log in and obtain a bearer token

parameters.description: Login credentials (username or email, plus password)
parameters.name: body

200.description: object with the JWT token and the authenticated user

get.description: Returns the identity (id, username, email, display name) of the user owning the bearer token. Read-only. Useful to confirm who the token belongs to before taking actions.
get.summary: Get the current authenticated user

get.description: Returns the MLflow registered models visible to a project, filtered by the project's AI storage prefix. Read-only. The project query param (project UUID) is required.
get.summary: List MLflow registered models for a project

get.description: Returns all versions of one MLflow registered model, filtered by the project's AI storage prefix. Read-only. The project query param (project UUID) is required.
get.summary: List versions of an MLflow registered model

get.description: Returns a single MLflow registered-model version, including its artifact source URI, scoped to the project's AI storage prefix. Read-only. The project query param (project UUID) is required.
get.summary: Get one MLflow model version

get.description: Returns every project the authenticated user is a member of, each annotated with the caller's role in that project. Read-only. Start here to discover project IDs for other calls.
get.summary: List projects the caller can access

get.description: Returns one project, the caller's role, and the project's environments (each with id, name, namespace, runtime). Read-only. Use the returned environment IDs for app/database/model calls.
get.summary: Get a project with its environments

200.description: object with project, role and environments

get.description: Returns all app servers (provisioned or connected VMs) in a project, excluding deleted ones, newest first. Read-only.
get.summary: List app servers (VMs) in a project

post.description: Creates an app server either by provisioning a new VM via Terraform (mode=terraform, the default) or by connecting an existing VM over SSH (mode=manual, requires vm_ip and ssh_private_key). Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.
post.summary: Provision or connect an app server (VM)

get.description: Returns one app server's record (status, VM IP, provider, Portainer endpoint) by name. Read-only.
get.summary: Get an app server (VM) by name

delete.description: Destructive: tears down the app server. For Terraform-provisioned servers this destroys the underlying VM and is irreversible. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.

get.description: Returns time-series CPU, memory, disk and network metrics for an app server (VM) from the central Prometheus. Read-only. The range query param selects the window (15m, 1h, 6h, 24h; default 1h).
get.summary: Get VM resource metrics for an app server

200.description: object with range, step and metrics series

get.description: Returns the live state of an app server: online/heartbeat from Portainer plus the running containers, falling back to the stored DB status when no live endpoint exists. Read-only.
get.summary: Get live state of an app server (VM)

200.description: object with status, online flag and containers

get.description: Returns all App resources (Helm or compose) in a project environment, with their live phase/status. Read-only.
get.summary: List apps in an environment

200.description: object with an apps array of ResourceSnapshot

post.description: Provisions a new app in an environment. For Kubernetes (Helm) environments image is required and port/replicas/profile apply; for VM (compose) environments the app deploys as a Docker Compose stack onto the environment's app server, which must already be Ready. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.

get.description: Returns all public API endpoints (PublicApi resources / domains) registered for an app in an environment, with their live phase/status. Read-only.
get.summary: List public endpoints of an app

200.description: object with an endpoints array of ResourceSnapshot

post.description: Registers a public API endpoint (PublicApi resource) exposing an app at a given FQDN, with optional auth (none, platform-jwt, api-key, internal) and Swagger publishing. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.
post.summary: Register a public endpoint (domain) for an app

patch.description: Rolls an existing app to a new container image. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.
patch.summary: Deploy a new image version for an app

get.description: Returns the last N lines of a single container's logs for a VM (compose) app, proxied from Portainer. Read-only. The container query param (container id) is required; tail defaults to 200 (max 5000).
get.summary: Get recent logs of a compose app container

parameters.description: Container id to read logs from
parameters.name: container

parameters.description: Number of log lines to return (1-5000, default 200)
parameters.name: tail

get.description: Returns time-series CPU and memory metrics for a compose app's containers from the central Prometheus. Read-only. The range query param selects the window (15m, 1h, 6h, 24h; default 1h).
get.summary: Get container resource metrics for an app

200.description: object with range, step and metrics series

get.description: Returns the live Docker Compose stack + container state for a VM (compose) app, queried from Portainer. Read-only. Returns 503 when live state is not configured.
get.summary: Get live state of a compose app

200.description: object with stack, online flag and containers

post.description: Issues a short-lived delegate token plus WebSocket URL that the frontend uses to open a live editing session against the gitops-agent values editor for an app's config file (values.yaml, compose.yaml or .env). Requires write access. Returns 503 when the values editor is not configured.
post.summary: Issue a short-lived token for the app values editor

parameters.description: Config file to edit: values.yaml, compose.yaml or .env (default values.yaml)
parameters.name: file

get.description: Returns all managed PostgreSQL (ServiceDatabaseV2) resources in the given project environment, with their live phase/status.
get.summary: List databases in an environment

200.description: object with a databases array of ResourceSnapshot

post.description: Provisions a new managed PostgreSQL database (ServiceDatabaseV2) attached to an app. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until it reaches a terminal status. NOTE: the ServiceDatabaseV2 composition is currently blocked upstream, so reconcile may fail until that is fixed.

get.description: Returns all AIModel resources in a project environment, with their live phase/status. Read-only.
get.summary: List AI models in an environment

200.description: object with a models array of ResourceSnapshot

post.description: Provisions a new AIModel from an MLflow registered version, an S3 artifact URI, or a custom container image. GPU profiles land in WaitingForApproval when the project's GPU quota is 0 (non-admins) or are rejected when over quota. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.

get.description: Returns one AIModel snapshot plus its API key prefix (never the plaintext key). Read-only.
get.summary: Get an AI model by name

200.description: object with the model and api_key_prefix

delete.description: Destructive: removes an AIModel. By default the deletion is blocked while an app is attached; force=true bypasses that guard and is platform-admin only. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.

parameters.description: Force delete even if an app is attached (platform-admin only)
parameters.name: force

get.description: One-shot reveal of an AI model's plaintext API key, created when the model was deployed. The reveal window is short-lived and single-use; returns 410 once consumed or expired. Requires reveal=true and write access. Only the original requester or a platform-admin may consume it.
get.summary: Reveal an AI model's API key (one-shot)

parameters.description: Must be true to consume the reveal
parameters.name: reveal

patch.description: Points an existing AIModel at a new artifact, either by a direct artifact_uri or by an mlflow_name + mlflow_version pin. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.

parameters.description: Object with artifact_uri, or mlflow_name + mlflow_version
parameters.name: body

patch.description: Sets the percentage of traffic routed to the model's canary (latest) revision (0-100). Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.
patch.summary: Set canary traffic percentage for an AI model

post.description: Proxies an inference request to the in-cluster KServe predictor for a deployed AI model and returns the prediction. The request and response bodies are passed through transparently (KServe v1 or v2 protocol depending on model type). Playground use only — production traffic should go through the model's public endpoint. The model must be Ready (otherwise 503).
post.summary: Run inference against a deployed model (playground)

parameters.description: Inference payload (KServe v1/v2 predict request, passed through verbatim)
parameters.name: body

200.description: the upstream predictor response, passed through verbatim

patch.description: Pins an existing AIModel to a specific MLflow registered model + version. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.
patch.summary: Pin an AI model to an MLflow version

post.description: Promotes the model's canary (latest) revision to 100% of traffic, clearing the canary split. Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation; poll the operation until terminal.
post.summary: Promote an AI model's canary to 100%

put.description: Updates the Kubernetes LimitRange and ResourceQuota for an environment's namespace. Admin-only (platform-admin or client-admin). Asynchronous: returns 202 with an operation id; poll the operation endpoint until terminal.
put.summary: Set an environment's namespace LimitRange + ResourceQuota

parameters.description: Object with limit_range and resource_quota JSON specs
parameters.name: body

202.description: object with the accepted operation id

get.description: Runs an aggregated Elasticsearch log search scoped to the project. Read-only. At least one of vm or app is required and must belong to the project (prevents reading another tenant's logs). q is a free-text filter; since selects the window (15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d; default 1h); size caps results (1-1000, default 200).
get.summary: Search aggregated logs in a project

parameters.description: App server (VM) name to scope logs to
parameters.name: vm

parameters.description: App name to scope logs to
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: Max log entries to return (1-1000, default 200)
parameters.name: size

200.description: object with a log entries array

get.description: Returns the 50 most recent async operations for a project (newest first), with their current status. Read-only. Use this to track the outcome of create/update/delete calls.
get.summary: List recent operations in a project

get.description: Returns the current state (status, error, git/argo metadata) of a single async operation. Read-only. Poll this after any create/update/delete call until the operation reaches a terminal status (Ready or Failed).
get.summary: Get the state of an async operation

post.description: Re-queues a failed operation for another processing attempt (resets it to Created and clears the prior error). Only operations in the Failed state can be retried. Asynchronous: returns 202 with the re-queued operation; poll it until terminal.

get.description: Returns the project's CPU/GPU model quota limits, the number of models currently in use, and the advisory monthly inference-call counter. Read-only.
get.summary: Get a project's quotas and usage

200.description: object with quota limits and current usage

vm_ip.description: Manual-mode fields (connecting a pre-existing VM over SSH).
